_README: gh-1314 / PR #1856. Columns a merged code path writes that the PRODUCTION schema does not have YET,
because their migration is drafted and awaiting the migration gate + Dustin's approval.
Every entry is a DECLARED, GREPPABLE gap, not a suppression:
- schema-column-lint.py prints it as a loud PENDING line, on every run, in the CI log;
- the named migration file MUST exist, or the lint fails;
- once the migration is applied and sql/schema-snapshot.json is refreshed, the entry becomes STALE
and the lint FAILS until it is deleted. A declaration cannot outlive the gap it describes.
Adding an entry here is not a way to skip a migration. It is a way to say, in one greppable place,
which migration a merged writer is waiting on -- instead of leaving `main` red with no owner named.

signed_price_raw.note: pre-parse string; unparseable is a real state

signed_price_reason.note: PriceEvaluation.reason; CHECK covers all five UnverifiedReason values

signed_price_checked_at.note: when the reconciliation last ran for this claim

alerted_at.note: router-lead admin-alert dedupe stamp -- notify-admin-new-homeowner's handleRouterLead() claims a lead atomically via UPDATE ... WHERE alerted_at IS NULL before sending

next_step_reminder_sent_at.note: LRS HO-1 S21 next-step reminder idempotency stamp -- send-lead-next-step-reminder claims a lead atomically via UPDATE ... WHERE next_step_reminder_sent_at IS NULL before sending; migration not yet applied (kill switch inserted OFF pending PR merge)

next_step_reminder_opted_out_at.note: LRS HO-1 S21 D-320-style opt-out stamp, written by the lead-next-step-optout Edge Function; migration not yet applied

referral_agent_id.note: gh-2154 P-3 review round 2 (REVIEW FAIL 5832785581, corrected per REVIEW FAIL 5833567534 must-fix 1): notify-admin-new-partner dedupes on the partner's own id, not user_id (NULL at signup). Migration is committed but not yet applied to prod -- correct go-live order per PR #2170: apply 131429 first and read it back (column + partial index + FK present), then deploy the EF with a byte read-back, then apply the trigger migration 20260924200316 (which now guards on this column's presence) and read it back with one synthetic is_test insert producing a notifications row.

onboarding_opted_out_at.note: gh-2154 P-4 (Kevin correction Q1): permanent partner-level opt-out gate, written by partner-email-optout/index.ts and read by send-partner-onboarding's selectStage. Migration is committed (stacked with the rest of P-4's ledger table + claim function) but not yet applied to prod -- this entry was missing from schema-pending.json until the P-4 fix round (REVIEW FAIL 5833587935) caught it via schema-column-lint.py's FAIL on partner-email-optout/index.ts:209.

attempt_count.note: gh-2154 P-4 switch-on hardening item (3) retry cap: total claim attempts for this (partner_id, stage) row; written by claim_partner_onboarding_stage(), read by send-partner-onboarding's markFailed wiring. APPLY-BEFORE-MERGE for this PR -- see its body's go-live order.

terminal_failure.note: gh-2154 P-4 switch-on hardening item (3): set true on a permanent (4xx-other-than-429) Mailgun rejection; blocks all further reclaim regardless of attempt_count. APPLY-BEFORE-MERGE for this PR.

uncertain_alerted_at.note: gh-2154 P-4 switch-on hardening item (2): admin-alert dedupe marker for an uncertain-outcome row; written by send-partner-onboarding's markUncertainAlerted. APPLY-BEFORE-MERGE for this PR. NOTE: schema-column-lint.py currently reports the whole partner_onboarding_sends table as 'not found in schema snapshot' (a WARN, not a FAIL) rather than flagging each column individually -- this entry exists for the same greppable-declaration reason as this file's other entries, ahead of the table itself being added to sql/schema-snapshot.json.
